concerns.text: FR‑001 (dataset‑download script) is not implemented – task T009 is still unchecked, leaving the required download utility absent.
FR‑002 (Full‑Parameter OPD baseline) is missing – task T015 (baseline script) is unchecked, so the baseline required by the spec is not provided.
FR‑003 (SVD computation) is missing – task T016 (SVD compute script) is unchecked, leaving the subspace‑identification step uncovered.
FR‑004 (binary mask generation) is missing – task T018 (mask generation) is unchecked, so the mask required for frozen‑subspace training is absent.
FR‑005 (comparative SFT with OPD mask and random mask) is missing – tasks T025, T026, T027 are all unchecked, leaving both mask‑generation and SFT scripts unimplemented.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – User Story 1 & Phase 4 – User Story 2
concerns.text: FR‑006 (paired seed orchestration for N=30 seeds) is incomplete – orchestrator tasks T015b, T016b, T019b, T026b remain unchecked, so the required 30‑seed evaluation pipeline is not established.
FR‑016 (logging utility for RAM & wall‑clock) is missing – task T007 (logging utility) is still unchecked, violating the spec’s requirement for a dedicated logging module.
FR‑008 (sensitivity analysis sweep over variance thresholds) is missing – task T017 (sensitivity sweep) is unchecked, so the required sweep is not performed.
FR‑009 (pre‑study power analysis for OPD TOST) is absent – no task implements the power‑analysis step required before the equivalence test.
FR‑010 (loss‑landscape logging: per‑epoch loss, ΔL, plateau detection) is not covered – no task creates or tests the JSON‑lines loss‑logging required by the spec.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Phase 3 – User Story 1 & Phase 4 – User Story 2
concerns.text: FR‑011 (reporting achieved statistical power) is missing – there is no task that records or validates power metrics in the final artifacts.

FR‑007 (logging peak RAM & wall‑clock for every run) is only partially addressed by resource‑monitor tests; the spec requires logging via `src/utils/logging.py`, but the logging utility itself (T007) is not implemented.
FR‑018 (authoritative `state.yaml` artifact) is missing – task T054 (state.yaml generation) is unchecked, leaving the Single Source of Truth undefined.
FR‑019 (schema validation of experiment artifacts) is incomplete – task T055 (CI step to validate `state.yaml`) is unchecked, so CI does not enforce schema compliance.
FR‑020 (mask derived from independent 10 seeds) is missing – task T052 (mask‑derivation using 10 independent seeds) is unchecked, violating the independence requirement.
FR‑021 (power analysis for paired t‑tests in US‑2) is absent – no task implements the power‑analysis described in FR‑021.
SC‑001 (paired TOST equivalence test for OPD) is not covered – task T021 (statistical analysis module) is unchecked, leaving the required equivalence test unimplemented.
SC‑002 (SFT accuracy‑drop predicate) is only partially addressed by task T051, which remains unchecked; the concrete measurable predicate required by the spec is therefore missing.
SC‑005 (variance‑explained ≥ 95 % threshold) is not verified – no completed task checks that the selected subspace meets the 95 % variance criterion.
SC‑006 (robustness across variance thresholds 90 %, 95 %, 99 %) is missing – the sensitivity sweep (T017) and associated checks are unchecked, so robustness is not measured.
